# Managed And Serverless Vector DBs

- [Amazon Aurora Serverless v2](https://aws.amazon.com/rds/aurora/serverless/) - Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 is a cloud-hosted, serverless relational database (Postgres/MySQL compatible) with pgvector support for managed vector workloads, featuring auto-scaling compute/memory, pay-per-use pricing, automated backups, and multi-AZ/multi-region high availability. Suited for enterprise RAG via Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases and production AI apps. Provides easier operations than self-hosted Milvus or Postgres, deeply integrated with AWS unlike standalone Zilliz.
